items.statement: The supplied reactants and independently generated neutral azo product plus hydroxide coproduct are optimized and characterized as minima.
items.expected: Each retained minimum has explicit charge/multiplicity and no imaginary frequency; the full endpoint conserves all 18 atoms and total charge -1.

items.statement: The retained coupling saddle point is validated as a first-order TS and connected to the intended reactant and azo-product basins.
items.expected: One relevant imaginary mode plus IRC or equivalent connection evidence links the TS to the supplied reactants and atom-balanced neutral azo plus hydroxide product basin.

items.statement: The base-assisted coupling activation free energy is approximately the published value.
items.expected: Activation free energy near 13.35 kcal/mol under the submitted convention.

items.statement: The atom-balanced coupling to neutral azo product plus hydroxide is exergonic.
items.expected: Reaction free energy near -29.58 kcal/mol for separated neutral azo product plus hydroxide relative to the separated supplied reactants, under an explicit common free-energy convention.
